title: Tivic Health Systems, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Tivic Health Systems, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing a corporate name change from Tivic Health Systems, Inc. to Valion Bio, Inc., effective April 28, 2026. The company also changed its ticker symbol from TIVC to VBIO on The Nasdaq Capital Market LLC. This was a routine corporate administrative filing under Item 5.03 (Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws).
key_points: Company name changed from Tivic Health Systems, Inc. to Valion Bio, Inc.
Certificate of Amendment filed with Delaware Secretary of State on April 22, 2026.
Effective date of name change: April 28, 2026.
Ticker symbol changed from TIVC to VBIO on The Nasdaq Capital Market LLC.
Shareholder vote was not required for the name change under Delaware law.
Press release issued on April 23, 2026 announcing the change.
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate name and ticker change with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. The filing is notable only for investors holding shares under the old ticker TIVC, who must update their records to trade under VBIO. It has no bearing on monetary policy, interest rates, market operations, or broader economic conditions.
